title: Laser Swords
description: This resource pack features custom sword textures and updated visuals for the strength and weakness effects.
body:
# ⚔️ Laser Swords - Custom Swords & Status Visuals

Transform your Minecraft combat experience with a complete visual overhaul for your weaponry and status effects! This resource pack introduces uniquely styled, vibrant custom sword textures alongside cleaner, more intuitive visuals for combat-related status effects.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🔹 Legendary Custom Swords
The centerpiece of this resource pack is the reimagined sword lineup. Say goodbye to the standard, boring vanilla blades and wield powerful, glowing elemental weapons:
* **Unique Textures:** Every sword tier features a custom pixel-art design with a striking, flammant energy-blade appearance.
* **Vibrant Blue Energy:** Designed with sharp, glowing blue gradients that look stunning in both PvP battles and casual survival mode.
* **Sleek Hilt Designs:** Detailed guards and handles that look perfect in both first-person and third-person perspectives.

### 💥 Enhanced Status Effect Visuals
To give you a better edge and cleaner visibility in combat, the visual indicators for key status effects have been completely redesigned:
* **💪 Strength Effect:** Cleaner, more distinct particles and a modernized icon that clearly signals when you are powered up and ready to deal massive damage.
* **🌀 Weakness Effect:** Rewritten visuals that instantly notify you when your attack power is compromised, without cluttering your screen during intense fights.

---

## 📸 Preview & Style

The pack stays true to the classic **Minecraft Pixel-Art Style** ($16\times16$ / $32\times32$ feel) while delivering a powerful fantasy punch. It fits perfectly into any PvP setup, vanilla+ client, or modded adventure.

---

## ⚙️ Installation Guide

1. Download the latest `.zip` file of the resource pack.
2. Open Minecraft and navigate to **Options** > **Resource Packs** > **Open Pack Folder**.
3. Drag and drop the downloaded `.zip` file into the folder.
4. Select the pack from the "Available" list to move it to "Selected", then click **Done**!

*Note: For the best visual experience and potential emissive (glowing) textures, using **OptiFine** or the **Iris/Sodium** stack with **ETF (Enhanced Block Entities)** / **EMF** is highly recommended, though the pack works perfectly in pure vanilla!*

---

## 🛠️ Compatibility

* **Minecraft Versions:** Compatible with all recent versions of Minecraft (simply ignore the version warning if it appears, the textures will load perfectly!).
* **Mods:** Works seamlessly alongside combat mods, HUD improvements, and texture changes that don't overwrite item models.
